messages:
maria (People Ops): Quick sync: planning a surprise "Sunrise Spot" drop for next Friday during team standups. Need assembly lead, CSV QA, and courier plan for two small APAC packages.
owen (Events): I can run assembly in SF on Thurs 6/20 4-6pm. How many kits and what's inside?
maria (People Ops): Totals: SF 18, NY 14, Remote 25, APAC 3. Contents: enamel pin, note card (handwritten by manager), mini snack, "do not open" sticker, and a tiny thank-you postcard.
lee (Logistics): I'll QA the CSV and run postal validation. Please send raw list by 6/18 EOD. For APAC, need customs CN22s if value > $20.
cam (Finance): Budget: code 9-RECOG-2026. If unit cost > $16 flag me. Vendor pin invoice cleared.
kit-bot: Inventory check: pins 80, snacks 70, cards 100, mailers 40.
owen (Events): Volunteers: owen, jules, kaori. Need one more for SF.
maria (People Ops): Can someone own preprinting blank cards and a short manager prompt? Suggest: "One line: Thanks for.."
owen (Events): I'll print blank cards and a one-liner prompt sheet. Bringing pens + label printer.
lee (Logistics): I'll post cleaned CSV by 6/19 noon. Courier pickup for APAC booked for 6/21 09:00 PT.
maria (People Ops): Timeline summary: 6/18 raw CSV -> 6/19 QA -> 6/20 SF assembly -> 6/21 remote/APAC ship. Thanks all!
